info.title: End Close API
info.description: REST API is used to interact with the End Close platform.

description.description: Optional description of the data stream

type.description: The type of data stream (e.g. api, csv, stripe, bank_feed)

BulkRequestSummary.description: Summary returned when a bulk request is created or retrieved via idempotency key

id.description: Unique identifier for the bulk request

processed_items.description: Number of records processed so far

skipped_items.description: Number of records skipped due to `on_conflict: skip` matching an existing `external_id`

BulkRequest.description: Full bulk request payload, returned by show, list, cancel, and retry endpoints.

status.description: pending = queued, processing = records being inserted, completed = all rows processed, failed = job errored, cancelled = cancellation honored on a heartbeat

skipped_items.description: Records skipped due to `on_conflict: skip` matching an existing `external_id`

filename.description: Original filename for CSV/NACHA uploads. Null for API-submitted requests.

last_progress_at.description: Heartbeat timestamp from the worker; used to detect stuck jobs

cancellation_requested_at.description: Set by POST /bulk_requests/{id}/cancel; the worker exits at its next heartbeat

parsing.description: True while a CSV/NACHA upload is still being parsed (before rows are enqueued)

stuck.description: True if the request has been `processing` for more than 5 minutes without a heartbeat

error_details.description: Free-form structured error context (e.g. row indices, validation errors)

parent_bulk_request_id.description: If this request is a retry, the ID of the original (parent) bulk request

on_conflict.description: Conflict policy applied when an `external_id` already exists in the stream

data_stream_id.description: Data stream the request targets, when applicable

DataStreamOperation.description: Async operation against a data stream (delete or reset). Poll via GET /data_streams/{key}/operations/{id}.

DataStreamHealth.description: Ingestion health snapshot for a data stream. All counts are indexed lookups; safe to poll.

import_batches_record_sum.description: Sum of `record_count` across all import batches. Drift from `records_count` indicates orphaned or extra records.

orphan_records_count.description: Records on this stream with no `import_batch_id` (typically created via POST /records or POST /records/bulk)

stuck.description: Currently `processing` with no heartbeat for >5 minutes

last_ingestion_at.description: Most recent record `created_at` on this stream

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. USD, EUR). **Optional on create — defaults to `USD` when omitted.** Case-insensitive on input; always returned uppercase.

decimal_places.description: Number of decimal places for this currency (2 for USD)

ReconciliationEntry.description: A record's entry in one reconciliation. Match status, escalation, and matched records are all scoped to that reconciliation; a record has one entry per reconciliation it participates in. `id` is the record id.

status.description: Whether the record is matched in this reconciliation. Read-only.

matched_records.description: Records matched with this record in this reconciliation

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. USD, EUR)

reconciliation_id.description: The reconciliation in which this match was made

reconciliation_name.description: Name of the reconciliation in which this match was made

days_unreconciled.description: Number of days since the record's date. Null when the record is reconciled.

exception_id.description: Open exception covering this entry's data stream when the entry is escalated. Null otherwise.

name.description: Human readable name for the reconciliation

side_a_streams.description: Data streams on side A of the reconciliation

side_b_streams.description: Data streams on side B of the reconciliation

current_run.description: The currently pending or running batch run, if any

last_run.description: The most recent completed or failed batch run, if any

ReconciliationRun.description: A single execution of a reconciliation's batch or continuous matching pipeline.

total_records.description: Total records considered by the run

matched_records.description: Records that were matched during the run

rule_summary.description: Per-rule match counts, populated as the run progresses

filters.description: A rule tree with group nodes (AND/OR) and condition leaf nodes. Conditions compare a field on one side to a field on the other side.

operand.description: Logical operator for combining child rules

tolerance_amount.description: Optional tolerance for fuzzy matching with the 'eq' operand. Must be a positive number.

tolerance_unit.description: Unit for tolerance. 'dollar' and 'percent' for number fields, 'day' and 'month' for date fields. 'month' matches records in the same calendar month (tolerance_amount is ignored).

transforms.description: Optional transforms applied to field values before comparison. Each side (key/value) can have a single transform string, a parameterized transform object, or an array of transforms applied in order (first = innermost). Available transforms: lowercase, uppercase, alphanumeric_only, digits_only, first_n_chars (requires {"name": "first_n_chars", "args": {"n": 8}}).

key.description: Transform(s) for the Side A (key) field.

value.description: Transform(s) for the Side B (value) field.

group_by.description: Side A field keys to group records by before matching. The first key is the primary axis: in `rollup.group_by_kind` 'date' mode it must be a date field; in 'identifier' mode it can be any field (e.g. a batch id in metadata). Additional keys further segment Side A — in date mode each segment matches only Side B records with the same value for those fields; in identifier mode they form a composite cohort key.

cardinality.description: Match cardinality. 'one_to_one' matches single records on each side. 'many_to_one' rolls up multiple records on one side to match a single record on the other side — requires the `rollup` field to be set.

rollup.description: Required when cardinality is 'many_to_one'. Configures how records on the many side are aggregated before matching.

lookback_days.description: Optional. Number of days of history to include when rolling up records. Must be set together with `date_field`. Omit both to match without a time bound.

date_field.description: Optional. The date field on the rolled-up records used to anchor the lookback window. Must be set together with `lookback_days`.

group_by_kind.description: How `group_by` is interpreted. 'date' (default) buckets records per day and walks a date-window running sum. 'identifier' buckets records by exact value (e.g. a batch id) and matches the bucket total to one record on the other side, optionally bounded by the lookback window.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of what this rule matches

source.description: Origin of the rule. 'user' = created manually via the API or UI. 'ai' = created by the AI rules engine. 'default' = seeded built-in rule.

status.description: Active rules are used by the reconciliation engine. Proposed rules are awaiting review from a cold start.

confidence.description: AI confidence rating. Only present on AI-generated rules from cold start.

sample_match_rate.description: How many sample records this rule matched during dry-run evaluation (e.g. '42/50'). Only present on AI-generated rules from cold start.

ReconciliationMatch.description: A reconciliation match represents a group of records that have been matched together. Endclose supports many-to-one matching, so a single match can contain a large number of records — to retrieve them, use `GET /v1/records?reconciliation_match_id={id}`.

record_count.description: Total number of records in this match

ReconciliationStory.description: A reconciliation story groups related reconciliations into an ordered chain so end-to-end flow can be tracked. Each link points to a reconciliation; non-origin links must specify the data stream that connects them to the previous reconciliation in the chain.

name.description: Human readable name for the story

links.description: Ordered list of reconciliations participating in the story

position.description: 1-indexed position in the chain. Must be unique within a story.

role.description: The first link is the 'origin'. All subsequent links are 'continuation' and must set shared_data_stream_id.

reconciliation_id.description: The reconciliation this link points to

shared_data_stream_id.description: The data stream that connects this link to the previous link in the chain. Required for continuation links, null for origin.

ReconciliationException.description: A reconciliation exception represents unmatched overdue records that need human attention. Exceptions are scoped to a (reconciliation, data_stream) tuple and managed by the sweeper job — record membership is computed on read from the set of unmatched records whose `overdue_at` has passed.

reconciliation_id.description: The reconciliation this exception belongs to

data_stream_id.description: The data stream this exception is scoped to

data_stream_name.description: Human-readable name of the scoped data stream

data_stream_key.description: Immutable key of the scoped data stream

opened_at.description: When the exception most recently transitioned into an open state. Distinct from `created_at` so reopening is tracked cleanly.

closed_at.description: When the exception most recently transitioned into a resolved or dismissed state. Cleared on reopen.

decimal_places.description: Number of decimal places (2 for USD)

aggregates.description: Whole-exception aggregates over the current unmatched overdue slice.

filtered_aggregates.description: Aggregates restricted to the filter query parameters. Equals `aggregates` when no filter is supplied. Only present on the show response.

comments.description: Comments on this exception, oldest first

mentions.description: User IDs mentioned in the comment

investigation.description: The most recent agent investigation session for this exception, if any.

investigation_sessions.description: Up to the five most recent investigation sessions, newest first. Exceptions may accumulate multiple sessions as the overdue set evolves.

ExceptionAggregates.description: Summary statistics for the (filtered) set of unmatched overdue records behind an exception.

record_count.description: Number of matching overdue unmatched records

total_amount.description: Sum of signed amounts in cents (debits are negative)

debit_sum.description: Sum of debit amounts in cents (non-positive)

credit_sum.description: Sum of credit amounts in cents (non-negative)

avg_age_days.description: Average age in days since each record's `overdue_at`

oldest_at.description: Transaction date of the oldest record in the slice

newest_at.description: Transaction date of the newest record in the slice

AgentInvestigationSession.description: An agent-run investigation into an exception's record slice.

status.description: Investigation status (e.g. pending, running, completed, failed)

outcome.description: Standardized outcome of a completed investigation. `match_found` = confident candidate matches; `no_match` = thorough search returned nothing; `needs_review` = candidates found but signals are weak. Null when the session is not yet completed or failed.

recommendation_text.description: Agent's recommendation once the investigation completes

candidate_records_searched.description: Number of candidate records the agent evaluated

suggested_record_ids.description: Records the agent suggests linking to this exception

filter_params.description: Filter parameters the session was scoped to, if any. Matches the filter shape on `GET /reconciliation_exceptions/{id}`.

ExceptionFilter.description: Optional filter parameters that narrow an exception's record slice. All fields are optional; omit or leave blank to match everything.

amount_min.description: Include records with signed amount >= amount_min (cents)

amount_max.description: Include records with signed amount <= amount_max (cents)

date_from.description: Include records with transaction date >= date_from

date_to.description: Include records with transaction date <= date_to

direction.description: Include only debits (amount < 0) or credits (amount > 0). Derived from the sign of `amount`, not from the record's reconciliation side.

counterparty.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the record description

age_bucket.description: Convenience filter on time since `overdue_at` (less-than-7-days, 7-to-30-days, 30-to-90-days, greater-than-90-days)

data_stream_key.description: Key of the data stream this import batch belongs to

record_count.description: Number of records in this batch

total_credits.description: Sum of credit amounts in cents

total_debits.description: Sum of debit amounts in cents

net_amount.description: Net amount in cents (credits minus debits)

decimal_places.description: Number of decimal places (2 for USD)

date_range_start.description: Earliest record date in the batch

date_range_end.description: Latest record date in the batch

records_url.description: URL to fetch records belonging to this batch

event_type.description: Description of the event (e.g. record.reconciled or record.reconciliation_overdue)

name.description: Human readable name for the bank account

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. USD, EUR). Must be uppercase. Optional — bank accounts may be created without a currency.

bank_account_id.description: ID of the bank account this balance belongs to

200.description: Return a 200 status to indicate that the data was received successfully

post.description: When a record has gone beyond its expected reconciliation date

200.description: Return a 200 status to indicate that the data was received successfully

type.description: The type of data stream to create

bank_account_id.description: Required when type is bank_feed. The ID of the bank account to link.

422.description: Validation error (e.g. missing required fields, duplicate key, bank_account_id not found)

delete.description:
Permanently deletes a data stream and all associated records and property definitions.

**Sync vs async:** Streams with at most 10,000 records are deleted synchronously and return 204. Streams above that threshold *must* be deleted asynchronously by passing `?async=true`; otherwise the request fails with 409. Callers may also opt into the async path explicitly for any size. The async path returns 202 with a `DataStreamOperation` payload; poll `GET /data_streams/{key}/operations/{id}` for progress.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The immutable data stream key

parameters.name: async
parameters.description: When `"true"`, run the delete asynchronously and return 202 + a `DataStreamOperation`. Required for streams with more than 10,000 records.

204.description: Data stream deleted synchronously (record count ≤ 10,000 and `async` not requested)

202.description: Async delete accepted. Poll `GET /data_streams/{key}/operations/{id}` (also set in the `Location` header) until `status` is `completed` or `failed`.

Location.description: URL of the operation to poll

409.description: Either (a) the stream is linked to reconciliations and cannot be deleted, or (b) it has more than 10,000 records and `?async=true` was not provided.

post.description: Asynchronously wipes all records on the stream while preserving stream config, property definitions, and reconciliation links. Always async. Poll the returned operation.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The immutable data stream key

202.description: Reset accepted. Poll `GET /data_streams/{key}/operations/{id}` (also set in the `Location` header).

Location.description: URL of the operation to poll

get.description: Cheap, indexed snapshot of ingestion health for the stream — record count, import batch totals, orphan records, bulk request counters by status, and last ingestion time. Safe to poll from the UI.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The immutable data stream key

get.description: Poll a delete or reset operation kicked off against this data stream. Returns the serialized `DataStreamOperation`.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The immutable data stream key

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The operation ID returned by DELETE /data_streams/{key} or POST /data_streams/{key}/reset

404.description: Operation not found or does not belong to this data stream

patch.description: Update the name or optional flag of a property definition.

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of records, newest first. At least one of `data_stream_key`, `reconciliation_match_id`, `reconciliation_id`, `external_id`, `import_batch_id`, or `bulk_request_id` is required.

Pagination is cursor-based: pass each response's `next_cursor` back as `cursor` until `next_cursor` is null. The legacy `offset` parameter and its `has_more`/`offset`/`total_count` response shape have been removed.

parameters.name: data_stream_key
parameters.description: Filter by data stream key

parameters.name: reconciliation_match_id
parameters.description: Filter to records that belong to the given match

parameters.name: reconciliation_id
parameters.description: Filter to records that have a status row in the given reconciliation

parameters.name: external_id
parameters.description: Filter to records with this exact `external_id`

parameters.name: import_batch_id
parameters.description: Filter to records created by this import batch

parameters.name: bulk_request_id
parameters.description: Filter to records created by this bulk request

parameters.name: created_after
parameters.description: ISO8601 lower bound on `created_at`

parameters.name: created_before
parameters.description: ISO8601 upper bound on `created_at`

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Filter via the joined import batch's `source`

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by match status

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's `next_cursor`. Omit for the first page.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Null when no more pages.

422.description: No scoping filter provided, or invalid `status`, `created_after`, or `created_before`

post.description: Submit up to 1,000 records for asynchronous processing. Returns immediately with a bulk request ID. Each record is validated and inserted independently, so some records can succeed while others fail. Use the `GET /bulk_requests/{id}` endpoint to poll for results.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional idempotency key. If a bulk request with this key already exists for your environment, the existing request is returned instead of creating a new one.

on_conflict.description: How to handle records whose `external_id` already exists in the target stream. `skip` (default) silently skips duplicates and counts them in `skipped_items`. `error` surfaces duplicates as per-row failures. Only applies to records with `external_id` set.

data_stream_key.description: Key of the data stream this record belongs to

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. USD, EUR). **Optional — defaults to `USD` when omitted.** Case-insensitive on input.

direction.description: Whether this is a credit or debit

422.description: Invalid request (e.g. records is not an array, empty, or exceeds 1,000 items)

get.description: Cursor-paginated list of bulk requests in your environment, ordered by `created_at` descending. Filter by data stream, status, or source.

parameters.name: data_stream_key
parameters.description: Filter to bulk requests targeting this data stream

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Filter by request source (e.g. `bulk_api`, `csv`, `nacha`)

parameters.name: created_after
parameters.description: ISO8601 lower bound on `created_at`

parameters.name: created_before
parameters.description: ISO8601 upper bound on `created_at`

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned by a previous call's `next_cursor`. Omit for the first page.

next_cursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` to fetch the next page. Null when no more pages.

get.description: Poll the status of an asynchronous bulk request. Returns the bulk request payload plus paginated per-row results. Results grow as processing continues, so only non-pending items are included.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The bulk request ID returned from POST /records/bulk

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of result items to return

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pagination offset for result items

200.description: Bulk request payload with paginated results

index.description: Zero-based position in the original request array

record_id.description: ID of the created record. Only present when status is successful

error.description: Error message. Only present when status is failed

post.description: Sets `cancellation_requested_at` so the running job exits cleanly to `cancelled` on its next heartbeat. Idempotent — re-cancelling just bumps the timestamp.

409.description: Bulk request is not in a cancellable status (must be `pending` or `processing`)

post.description: Creates a new bulk request that re-runs only the parent's failed and skipped items. The new request's `parent_bulk_request_id` points at the original.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the failed or cancelled bulk request to retry

202.description: Retry created and enqueued. Returns the **new** bulk request, not the parent.

409.description: Bulk request is not in a retryable status (must be `failed` or `cancelled`)

patch.description: Update a record's fields. The record **must have a status of `unreconciled`**. Records that are partially or fully reconciled cannot be modified.

parameters.description: The unique identifier of the record

409.description: Record cannot be modified because it has already been reconciled

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the record

409.description: Record cannot be deleted because it is already reconciled or partially reconciled

post.description: Flags a record as overdue within a specific reconciliation by setting the `overdue_at` timestamp on its reconciliation entry. The reconciliation and record are both named in the path — the subject is the (reconciliation, record) entry, so the same record can be overdue in one reconciliation and matched in another. The record's data stream must be part of the reconciliation. If no entry exists yet for the record and reconciliation, one is created so unmatched records can be flagged as overdue. Records already matched in this reconciliation cannot be marked overdue. Once overdue, the record is picked up by the exceptions sweeper and rolled into the data-stream-scoped exception for that reconciliation.

parameters.name: reconciliation_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the reconciliation the record should be marked overdue in

parameters.name: record_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the record

overdue_at.description: When the record should be considered overdue. Defaults to the current time.

200.description: The record's entry in the given reconciliation

409.description: Record is already matched in this reconciliation and cannot be marked overdue

422.description: Record's data stream is not part of the reconciliation, or invalid `overdue_at`

delete.description: Permanently deletes a story and unlinks it from all reconciliations. The reconciliations themselves are not deleted.

post.description: Create an exception for a reconciliation and data stream. Only one `open` or `investigating` exception can exist per (data stream, reconciliation) pair at a time. `title` defaults to `"{data_stream_name} — overdue records"`, and `status` defaults to `open`.
